BlackRock's September announcement of a Hong Kong dollar digital liquidity fund brought tokenized money-market products back into the institutional spotlight. The fund is designed to operate across traditional and on-chain channels, an indication that major asset managers see practical value in blockchain-based access. It does not mean BlackRock has moved $10 trillion on-chain. For investors searching for the best crypto to invest in, the development points toward networks and products that help financial activity reach actual users.

Remittix https://remittixpresale.io approaches that shift from the consumer side. The project wants digital assets to move into compatible bank accounts in local currency, while a wallet and live trading venue give people more reasons to stay in its ecosystem. Alongside two larger established assets, RTX provides a way to consider how finance might change at the application level.

Best Crypto to Invest In: Ethereum and Bitcoin

Ethereum (ETH) underpins a large share of decentralized finance, stablecoins and tokenized assets. When an institution explores on-chain fund shares, Ethereum and related smart-contract networks show why programmable financial infrastructure matters. ETH also has deep liquidity and established access through spot investment products.

Bitcoin (BTC) serves a different role. Its limited supply, large market and U.S. spot ETFs make it the most familiar digital asset for many investors. Recent ETF inflows indicate that institutional exposure remains active, although Bitcoin does not itself provide a direct answer to every payment or investment workflow.

BlackRock's September 10 fund announcement https://www.blackrock.com/cash/en-hk/press-release-t2 makes the distinction clear. Bitcoin and Ethereum offer exposure to established crypto infrastructure as those use cases expand.

Remittix Targets the Customer's Daily Financial Tasks

Remittix's PayFi plan is aimed at a simpler question than fund tokenization: how can someone send crypto and have another person receive local money in a bank account? The project is developing support for more than 30 fiat currencies, with potential relevance to international workers, remote teams and families transferring funds across borders.

Its broader crypto-finance offering https://remittixpresale.io can keep users engaged after a transfer. Their trading platform, Remittix Markets, is live with hundreds of perpetual pairs and millions in trading volume. Its iOS wallet has more than 10,000 downloads; a rebuilt app aims to connect payments, asset management and trading. Remittix Earn is planned, with advertised yields up to 22% APY on eligible crypto.

That is the appeal of an interconnected platform. Bringing those needs into one wallet could make the user relationship more valuable than any single feature considered on its own.

Why RTX Adds an Earlier-Stage Option

Remittix has passed $32 million raised from more than 40,000 participants and set November 24, 2026, for its token debut. The $36 million hard cap defines its presale ceiling. RTX is currently quoted at $0.21, while $0.46 is the announced final presale-stage price.

The upgraded dashboard makes token allocations easier to track, and the seven-day BINANCE500 campaign announced September 25 offers a 500% token bonus on qualifying purchases.

Ethereum and Bitcoin are established foundations for the broader shift BlackRock is exploring. Remittix is targeting the moment those digital assets need to become useful to ordinary customers. If its payments, wallet and trading products grow together, RTX could capture attention from buyers seeking an earlier-stage addition to the best crypto to invest in conversation.

Did BlackRock move $10 trillion on-chain?

No. Its September announcement concerned a Hong Kong tokenized liquidity fund.
